title: Sep 30 Results + Oct 1 Preview: Split Decision, But the Braves Get Another Shot
summary: We went .500 on Sep 30, but here's why tomorrow's Braves pick feels different

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About September 30th

We finished the day at .500, and honestly? That's baseball. Two wins, two losses, and a whole lot of lessons learned. The model called it right on the Yankees and Padres, but the Braves and Astros? Not so much. But before we dive into what went wrong, let's look at what actually happened.

## The Story Behind the Numbers

The Yankees pick was basically a coin flip at 50%, and it landed our way. The Padres came through as expected, showing why high-confidence picks often deliver. But those two misses? The Braves and Astros both had 62% confidence, and both fell short.

Here's what's interesting: the Braves loss stings a little less when you see who they're facing tomorrow. Same opponent, similar setup, and the model is still bullish on Atlanta.

## Tomorrow's Redemption Story: October 1st

Sometimes the model gives you a second chance, and October 1st is exactly that. The Braves host the Phillies again, and we're right back on Atlanta at 61% confidence.

Zack Wheeler takes the mound for Philadelphia—he's always a tough assignment. But the Braves counter with Brent Suter, and at home, this Atlanta lineup has been dangerous. The model sees enough edge here to make the Braves our top pick for tomorrow.

content.title: ⭐ October 1 Top Pick
content.sub: 61% win probability vs Phillies · Wheeler vs Suter · Home field advantage

content.value:
## Why We're Riding With Atlanta Again

You might be thinking: didn't they just lose yesterday? Fair question. But here's the thing about series baseball—momentum shifts game to game, and the home team getting another crack at the same opponent often finds adjustments.

The 61% confidence isn't screaming certainty, but it's solid. It's the kind of edge that, over time, builds winning records. Plus, there's something poetic about bouncing back from a miss with the exact same matchup.

**Tomorrow, we ride with the Braves. Again.**

author: Hana
